name: Monstercat Visualizer
description: Reference-based Ubuntu GNOME adaptation with live native widgets.

reference.creator: MarcoPixel
reference.fidelity: Independent reference-based adaptation; not a pixel-identical or complete Windows suite port.
notes: The white spectrum is driven by real system playback through CAVA. Track metadata and Previous/Play/Pause/Next use MPRIS.
Original Rainmeter player plug-ins and per-genre/album color extraction are not ported. Remote album-art fetching is not included.
